Container.Name: spoolroom-watcher
Container.Overview: The Spoolroom watcher notices finished 3D prints on your network and logs them into your Spoolroom, deducting filament from the right spools. It only makes outbound connections: to your printers and to spoolroom.app. 1) In Spoolroom, open Settings, Connections, Connect a Watcher, choose Unraid and generate a pairing code; paste it below. 2) Once the watcher shows Live in Spoolroom, add your printers under it there: Find printers scans your network (type your home network, such as 192.168.1.0/24, when asked), or add one by its address. Nothing is typed in the container. The watcher keeps itself up to date.
Container.Requires: A Spoolroom account and a pairing code from Settings, Connections, Connect a Watcher.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Watcher state (watermarks, lock, remote-access sign-in). Do not change it after the first run, or prints re-import.

Config.Name: Pairing code
Config.Description: From Spoolroom: Settings, Connections, Connect a Watcher (eight characters, like ABCD-EFGH). Used once, on the first start; the watcher then keeps its own token in the State folder, so this can stay or be cleared.

Config.Name: Watcher token
Config.Description: Instead of a pairing code: the watcher token itself (Reveal the token in Spoolroom; starts with swt_). Treat it like a password. Leave blank when using a pairing code.
